As your trusted dentist in Raleigh Falls, NC, our experienced team of dental professionals is dedicated to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Welcome to our Raleigh Falls office! Our office stands out with its modern atmosphere and advanced technology, making your dental experience stress-free. Our skillful and attentive team strongly believes that dental care and treatment start with patient comfort. Therefore, we designed our office and amenities with your health and well-being in mind. Our patients feel supported and at ease, leaving motivated and confident to care for their oral health.

Our Raleigh Falls location is conveniently situated in a suburban community, reachable via Interstate 440. It offers small-town charm with easy access to Meredith College and Raleigh-Durham International Airport. We provide care for the Raleigh Falls community and patients traveling from the nearby neighborhoods such as Knightdale, New Hope, Morrisville, and more. Our connection with clients goes beyond the dental chair. You are now part of the Riccobene family, where we are committed to providing the comfort and confidence you need for a healthy, painless smile!
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Raleigh office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.
We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!
To schedule a visit, feel free to call us or book an appointment online to get you in as soon as possible! We look forward to treating you and providing you with the comfort and care you deserve!
Yes! We have an amazing team of professionals ready to help you with your Invisalign® needs to discreetly straighten your teeth for a brighter, natural smile.

Absolutely. We recognize the importance of starting dental care as early as possible and make sure to provide kids and adults with pediatric or orthodontic care most comfortably and comprehensively as they deserve.

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!
Yes. Our expert team can remove your wisdom teeth before or after they come in. We prioritize your comfort throughout the process and make sure the removal process is painless and relaxing.
We understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Our office Hours are Monday-Thursday: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM, Friday: 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday. Our office is located at 4400 Falls of Neuse Rd., Suite 202, Raleigh Falls, NC 27609. We look forward to seeing you!

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

We use digital X-rays, which have a small sensor and X-ray film tabs, as well as panoramic X-rays, where you stand still while a machine rotates around your head and takes a single image of your entire mouth.

schemaMarkup.reviewBody: The staff is so friendly! From the front desk to the hygienist and dentist, I felt very welcomed. Had my first visit recently, and always a nice bonus when that included a cleaning and not just exam/xrays. Looking forward to my next cleaning!

It was my first time here, and it was great, just from the front desk to dental assistance and the dentist, everyone was really professional and took great care of me, and I'm looking forward to continuing with Riccobene to get that confident smile back.

I have an autoimmune disorder that causes oral blistering and requires quarterly perio-maintenance. I see Luigi Ungria as my dental technician, and he is absolutely awesome. He goes above and beyond to perform my cleanings with a minimum of discomfort. He is very caring and sympathetic to my problem.

Only been twice, but after the first trip, I decided to go back if I needed more help. They were the most considerate, kind, nice folks. That was true of today’s visit as well. Very, very professional, happy to answer any questions I had regarding the service I was receiving. Good group, Thanks.

The atmosphere is pleasant with a friendly staff. My dental procedure couldn't be better than other experiences I've had at a dentist's office. Hygienists did an excellent job and were very knowledgeable. I was very pleased with my visit.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What services does the Raleigh Falls location offer?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

How do I make an appointment at the Raleigh Falls office?

To schedule a visit, feel free to call us or book an appointment online to get you in as soon as possible! We look forward to treating you and providing you with the comfort and care you deserve!

Are Invisalign® available at Raleigh Falls?

Yes! We have an amazing team of professionals ready to help you with your Invisalign® needs to discreetly straighten your teeth for a brighter, natural smile.

Does the Raleigh Falls location provide pediatric dental services?

Absolutely. We recognize the importance of starting dental care as early as possible and make sure to provide kids and adults with pediatric or orthodontic care most comfortably and comprehensively as they deserve.

Can I get same-day emergency dental care in Raleigh Falls?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Is wisdom teeth removal available at this location?

Yes. Our expert team can remove your wisdom teeth before or after they come in. We prioritize your comfort throughout the process and make sure the removal process is painless and relaxing.

What cosmetic treatments are offered in Raleigh Falls?

We understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Where is the Raleigh Falls office, and what are the hours?

Our office Hours are Monday-Thursday: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM, Friday: 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday. Our office is located at 4400 Falls of Neuse Rd., Suite 202, Raleigh Falls, NC 27609. We look forward to seeing you!

Do you accept insurance or offer payment plans in Raleigh Falls?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

What X-ray technology or comfort options are available at this office?

We use digital X-rays, which have a small sensor and X-ray film tabs, as well as panoramic X-rays, where you stand still while a machine rotates around your head and takes a single image of your entire mouth.
